build_JitModelAnalysis: build a JitModelAnalysis object to trace a PyTorch model and calculate per-submodule statistics using JIT tracing
run_set_op_handle: run set_op_handle on a JitModelAnalysis to register custom operator handles for calculating flops or other statistics
run_by_operator: run by_operator on a JitModelAnalysis to get a Counter of statistics grouped by operator type for a submodule
run_by_module: run by_module on a JitModelAnalysis to get aggregated statistics across all operators grouped by submodule names
run_total: run total on a JitModelAnalysis to get the total aggregated statistic across all operators for a requested module
